caption: The drawing depicts a garment, likely a coat or tunic, rendered in black ink on a beige background. The garment is wide and flared, with long sleeves extending horizontally from the shoulders. There are two rectangular pockets, one placed on each side of the lower front section, both featuring symmetrical, rounded, and swirling decorative patterns inside. Decorative patterns are also present along the edges of the sleeves, the hemline at the bottom of the garment, and around the collar area, all consisting of repetitive, curving and looping lines. Additionally, a larger ornamental motif is placed in the center of the garment’s lower front, directly above the hem, as well as smaller symmetrical decorative elements on either side near the bottom. The drawing uses fine-line detailing with no shading or coloring apart from the black outlines on a plain background.
title: Child's Apron Dress
